name: row_sums
title: Sum each row of a simple triplet matrix, treating missing entries as zero.

origin.description: Sum each row of a simple triplet matrix, treating missing entries as zero.
origin.details: Sum each row of a simple triplet matrix, treating missing entries as zero.

origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

m <- simple_triplet_matrix(i=c(1,2,1), j=c(1,1,2), v=c(1,2,3), nrow=2, ncol=2)
print(row_sums(m))
